learning.title: A leftover .git/shallow entry from before the repository was recreated survives fetch --unshallow and fails the Paper provenance gate
learning.trigger: A ui / paper parity lane (runtime, entitlements or artifacts) fails with "Paper profile provenance: Incomplete shallow provenance history" on one runner while the others pass, although the job checked out with fetch-depth: 0.
learning.mistake: Read it first as history lost late in the job (the baseline failure came an hour after checkout), then as a checkout-depth problem. fetch-depth: 0 was already set and the log shows fetch --unshallow ran. The second failure ran the gate two minutes after checkout, on the same runner: across four runs bakery-hetzner-4 passed 0 of 2 paper-parity jobs, bakery-hetzner-2 5 of 5 and bakery-hetzner-1 1 of 1. A read-only look at hetzner-4 found .git/shallow holding one entry, 38f398e8c80c, a commit of the archived pre-recreation repository that no ref contains; hetzner-2 had no shallow file at all. A toy repository whose server still had the boundary commit did not reproduce it, because there --unshallow cleared the entry. So why it survives is an inference, that the current server does not have the commit and cannot send it, not something shown directly.
learning.rule: Before a gate that needs complete history, run scripts/ci/heal-stale-shallow.ts (the ci.yml step "Complete git history before the provenance gate" in each paper-parity job). It drops only entries whose commit is absent from the repository or that no branch, remote-tracking ref or tag contains, logs each one with its subject, keeps a real boundary and still fails on it, and changes nothing when git cannot answer. Do not re-provision a host, delete a workspace or weaken the gate to clear it.

verification.requirement: The step's log line "history: dropped stale shallow entry ..." names the entry on a runner that carries one, and shallow-after=false.
A repository with a real boundary (a depth-1 clone) still exits 1 and keeps the file byte for byte; tests/unit/ci-heal-stale-shallow_test.ts covers both.

learning.boundary: Other jobs that need full history on a runner with such an entry would hit the same refusal until they run the step; only the three paper-parity jobs do today.
